title: Virtual Compute: assisted credit operation
content:
## Use and effect

Virtual Compute — Post a negative correction to one original primary invoice line. This decreases the contract receivable by the supplied amount and records the same untaxed net component; the returned reference identifies the posted credit.

## Invocation

credit_compute_line_adb33dcc is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameter compute_holding_id

`compute_holding_id`: Id class — The compute contract reference for assisted credit, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.

## Parameter customer_id

`customer_id`: Id class — The customer profile reference for assisted credit, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.

## Parameter compute_event_id

`compute_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the approved incorrect arithmetic review for the original primary charge, copied from its successful review receipt or find_compute_events; use the identical review reference supplied in related_event_id.

## Parameter source_event_id

`source_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the original invoice line or payment being handled, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.

## Parameter related_event_id

`related_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the related export or approved review, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings or find_customers results, or the preceding successful consent receipt as applicable.

## Parameter amount

`amount`: Fixed-format class — The signed financial amount in units of USD to two decimals, supplied as a decimal number already rounded half-up to two decimal places at calculation completion; stored to two decimals, with no empty value.

## Successful receipt

The successful string receipt identifies the newly recorded assisted credit by its new business event reference and confirms its posted registration and the business effect described above.
